text:
marie (FinOps): Heads-up: Orchid Health renewal invoice INV-2026-045 looks wrong. Platform fee billed for full year, but contract amendment shows private deployment started 2026-07-01, so fee should be pro-rated. Need corrected invoice before renewal notice next Monday.
raj (Billing): can you paste the invoice line items?
marie (FinOps): PDF lines: ```INV-2026-045
Line 12: Private Deployment - Platform Fee - Qty: 1 - Period: 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - Amount: $120,000
Line 13: Migration proration credit - Amount: $0
Line 20: Support Tier: Platinum - Qty: 1 - Period: 01Jul2026-30Jun2027 - Amount: $36,000```
marie (FinOps): amendment AMEND-17 signed 2026-06-22. Contract RDW-ORCH-2024-A. link: https://contracts.redwood/rdw-orch-2024-a/amend-17
olivia (CS): Confirmed — CS & Sales agreed platform fee pro-rate for mid-year private swap. Customer expects corrected invoice.
sven (Sales): Sales ops created SO-1129 to request proration. Thought billing pipeline would apply automatically.
raj (Billing): Investigating. I can reproduce locally: proration job skipped this amendment because the amendment timestamp is 23:58 UTC and our job had an off-by-one edge case. Filing billing-engine ticket.
billing-bot: New issue created: BE-4983 "proration job skips amendments created in final minute of day" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-4983
marie (FinOps): We still need a manual correction now. Orchid needs corrected invoice and credit memo before sending renewal.
raj (Billing): Manual credit is feasible. Calculation: full platform fee $120,000 pro-rate for Jul-Dec (6 months) => $60,000 due, so credit $60,000. I'll draft credit memo + corrected invoice and attach amendment + sales ops ticket. Routing to finance lead for approval.
olivia (CS): I'll tell the customer we're issuing an internal correction and will follow up with the corrected invoice. Want to reassure them this isn't a pricing change.
sven (Sales): I approve a one-time credit up to $75k for this account. If finance needs explicit approval, add my sign-off.
marie (FinOps): Filed approval AR-6521. Raj, please include the amendment PDF and SO-1129 in the memo and add an auditor-friendly note with the pro-rate calc.
raj (Billing): Will do. ETA: draft credit + corrected invoice by EOD, final version tomorrow morning after sign-off.
billing-bot: BE-4983 updated: root cause identified (timestamp boundary), fix deployed to staging, backfill scheduled 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC.
marie (FinOps): Once credit is posted, finance will issue reversal in revenue ledger and send customer-facing notification. Please ping when BE-4983 is resolved so we can reconcile automated runs and close the backfill.
raj (Billing): Noted. I'll include calculation: 120,000 * 6/12 = 60,000, reference amendment id AMEND-17, and attach SO-1129.
olivia (CS): I'll prepare the customer message and attach the corrected invoice when ready.
marie (FinOps): Thanks. After invoice corrected, I'll update renewal calendar and confirm AR status. :white_check_mark:
